predecessors.name: Serbian Empire
predecessors.text: emerged from the collapse of the Serbian Empire

successors.name: Moravian Serbia
successors.text: the lordship ceased to exist as such when Stefan Lazarević established the Serbian Despotate

ledger.x: 1371: Vuk Branković's lordship emerges from the collapse of the Serbian Empire, capital Priština.
1373: after the death of Đurađ I Balšić of Zeta, Vuk captures Prizren, Peć and Metohija.
1412: peace between Stefan Lazarević and Đurađ Branković; the lordship is absorbed into the Serbian Despotate.

certainty.note: Page gives no area; modern Kosovo is a stand-in.
